answer: New grading power is rationed: each epoch a public admission orchard opens only a fixed number of seats, awarded to bids whose stake has remained untouched for fourteen days. A rotating three-peer prism then attests that the winner's predeclared funding graph does not merge with any already seated identity. Every later deposit must arrive along that single published river of wallets; an undeclared inbound transfer voids the seat and slashes the bid. Because slots are scarce and the funding path is locked in advance, spinning clones cannot outrun the audit or cheaply multiply votes.
